refnamediv.refpurpose: Export the CMS file to an array of PEM certificates

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
input_filename
The PEM-encoded CMS data to parse. Despite its name, this is the data itself, not a path to a file.
certificates
Filled with an array of PEM strings. Certificates and CRLs are only extracted from signed data; for other content types the array is left empty.
